notes.title: Radio Station v1.1
notes.content:
Hi! I tried to fix the bugs and update the game in various aspects so that you feel comfortable playing it.

Added

- Hints (Pointers to active and inactive objects).
- Interactive objects (Now you can interact with objects that were previously absent or not active).
- Added a mouse sensitivity slider.
- Transformation of locations (Some locations were completely redesigned or detailed with new objects).
- Now the flashlight is in the main character's hand.
- There are footprints in the snow.

Fixed

- The volume of sounds in certain moments has been reduced.
- Fixed minor bugs.
- Edited animations.
- After restarting the game, the sound volume in the game settings does not change.
